"use server"
// PROBE — compliant control for tests/unit/agent-actions-error-codes.test.ts.
import { logger } from "@/lib/logger"

export async function probeAction() {
    try {
        await Promise.reject(new Error("boom"))
        return { success: true }
    } catch (e) {
        logger("error", "probeAction failed", { error: String(e) })
        return { success: false, error: "ADD_POLICY_FAILED" }
    }
}
